lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows. Centroids maintain a relatively equidistant spacing of roughly 1.5 to 2 diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical columns of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a rectangular grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high pixel values on the superior edge and lower values on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least five high-luminance blobs are bounded within the dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered in the anterior and basal regions of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An irregular, high-intensity white mark or cluster of marks is visible on the mid-lateral flank, positioned vertically between the second and third visible horizontal rows of spots.
